profile.headline: code + scale + code
profile.summary:
I love coding and designing systems.
I love the challenges of high performance, scalability, and reliability.
I love cutting edge technologies (despite their bugs).
I love building high impact teams and moving fast.
I believe that the best solution is the one that works.
If I fail, at least I learned something.

I love science, nature, sports, swimming, farming, kids stuff, community outreach, and just about anything that keeps my mind and spirit alive.

My mission is to push myself and those around me beyond our limits, and to make a positive impact in this world.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Leading the development of a distributed, scalable, and highly performant log management platform as a cloud service for thousands of customers.
